title: Diagonal identity for transition isomorphisms
statement: Given a ringed space X, an index type I, opens U covering X, local sheaves of modules Fi, overlap isomorphisms φij, and a diagonal identity hdiag for every i and W ≤ U i, if the cocycle identity φik = φij ≫ φjk holds on all triple overlaps, then there exist a global sheaf of modules H and isomorphisms φi : H.over (U i) ≅ Fi i satisfying φi ≫ φij = φj on every overlap.

source.place: Sheaves, Section 00AK, Lemma 00AL (first proof) and Lemma 00AM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AL and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AM. Universe-small subcover argument supplied by N3.

proof.text: Construct the compatible-family sheaf componentwise and glue sections using the local sheaf axioms; hdiag and the cocycle show the projection and reconstruction maps are inverse.

theorem module_object_open_descent_aux
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
    (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (Fi : ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
    (φij : ∀ i j : I,
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj
          (Fi i) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
          (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Fi j))
    (hdiag : ∀ (i : I) (W : Opens X) (hi : W ≤ U i),
      (φij i i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hi)))) =
        𝟙 _) :
    (∀ (i j k : I) (W : Opens X)
      (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j) (hk : W ≤ U k),
      (φij i k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hk)))) =
        (φij i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) ≫
          (φij j k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hj hk))))) →
    ∃ (H : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (moduleRings X))
      (φi : ∀ i : I, H.over (U i) ≅ Fi i),
      ∀ (i j : I) (W : Opens X) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        (φi i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) ≫
            (φij i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) =
          (φi j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj)))
